description: A PHP trait providing methods for serialization and unserialization of dependency-injected services and entity storages in Drupal.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object properties for serialization by storing service IDs and entity type IDs, excluding non-serializable properties.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Restores services and entity storages from stored IDs after unserialization.
